headline: Sources: Giants' Brian Burns believed to have torn ACL
summary: Giants pass rusher Brian Burns is believed to have torn his ACL during Sunday's win over the  Titans, sources told ESPN and NFL Network.

headline: Ravens stun Cowboys in final seconds as Loop gains redemption
summary: Lamar Jackson, Tyler Loop and the Ravens delivered one of the most remarkable last-second victories in recent NFL history Sunday, thanks to a late fourth-quarter decision made by the Cowboys.

headline: Commanders set to re-add Austin Ekeler to RB room, sources say
summary: The Commanders are expected to sign free agent running back Austin Ekeler to their 53-man roster, pending a physical, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo.

headline: Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield Suffers Dislocated Thumb
summary: After today’s loss to the Vikings, Buccaneers head coach Todd Bowles told the media that quarterback Baker Mayfield suffered a dislocated thumb on his throwing hand, per Greg Auman of FOX Sports. Mayfield will have an MRI scan performed tomorrow, but the veteran passer is expected to miss time as a result of the injury. […]

headline: Bo Nix and Talanoa Hufanga lead the Broncos past the Rams 30-26 in a Sunday night thriller
summary: - Bo Nix didn't flinch from his slow start and Talanoa Hufanga didn't lose faith after dropping two interceptions Sunday night.

headline: Saints again on losing end of controversial fumble ruling
summary: The Saints walked away from Sunday's home loss to the Raiders just as confused about the application of the quarterback fumble rules as they were in Week 1.
